qualification: conditional functional comparison; synthetic sync, nominal trims, and no unique source attribution of the 10 V arrow

instrument.model: independent 1 Mohm / 48 pF circuit-loaded solves, followed by 10 MHz one-pole response

secondary_arrow_exploration.method: Fold each loaded, bandwidth-limited field into the stated number of phase bins. Identify the longest circular run whose bin-to-bin rise is less than 0.2 percent of the profile range, then subtract its endpoint from its starting level. This exploratory feature includes the post-step shoulder and pre-reset trough but is not stable enough to gate.
secondary_arrow_exploration.resolution_effect: At 64 bins the brief reset is merged into the falling run. At 128 versus 256 bins the R48/V20 estimate crosses the 7.5 V lower guideline. Neither value is a qualified measurement of the printed 10 V arrow.

conclusion: The model's two candidate nodes have similar full traces. The corrected 17 V crest check at X2:3 remains within tolerance, but this functional comparison cannot assign or qualify the 10 V annotation. Preserve TP8 as reference-incomplete; resolve the source-node relationship and a reset-excluding feature definition before tuning the stage.
